Container.Name: StandUpOrderGenerator-Stage
Container.Overview: Stand-Up Order Generator — randomizes daily scrum order, manages team rosters, time-off tracking, and daily facts. Multi-team support with Google OAuth authentication.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for all team data, settings, and time-off records

Config.Name: Google Client ID
Config.Description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud Console. Required for authentication.

Config.Name: Google Client Secret
Config.Description: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret from Google Cloud Console. Required for authentication.

Config.Name: Base URL
Config.Description: Public-facing URL of the app (no trailing slash). Used for Google OAuth redirect. Example: https://standup.mydomain.com

Config.Name: Super Admin Email
Config.Description: Gmail address of the super admin (you). Can create teams and manage all.

Config.Name: Session Secret Key
Config.Description: Random secret for signing session cookies. Generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))"
